_meta.description: 按业务线统计每日开店/认证数据

workflow.name: 每日开店/认证数据统计
workflow.description: 按业务线（微商城、门店、美业等）统计近一个月每日开店/认证通过数量
workflow.business_scenario: 运营需要监控各业务线每日开店和认证通过趋势

variants.name: 开店数据统计
variants.description: 统计每日各业务线开店数量
variants.sql_template: SELECT LEFT(created_at, 10) AS stat_date, SUM(CASE WHEN parent_node_no = '820000000058' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `微商城`, SUM(CASE WHEN parent_node_no = '820000000057' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `微小店`, SUM(CASE WHEN parent_node_no = '820000000147' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `门店`, SUM(CASE WHEN parent_node_no = '820000000059' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `美业`, SUM(CASE WHEN parent_node_no = '810007442800' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `普惠版`, SUM(CASE WHEN parent_node_no = '810006902200' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `爱逛`, SUM(CASE WHEN parent_node_no = '810006274300' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `教育`, SUM(CASE WHEN parent_node_no = '810006729200' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `有赞客`, COUNT(1) AS `当日总量` FROM dm_pay.pay_cc_org_relation WHERE org_type = 'MERCHANT_SERVICE_RELATION' AND biz_node_type = 'USER' AND created_at > '{{start_time}}' GROUP BY LEFT(created_at, 10) ORDER BY stat_date DESC

variants.name: 认证数据统计
variants.description: 统计每日各业务线认证通过数量
variants.sql_template: SELECT LEFT(audit_time, 10) AS stat_date, SUM(CASE WHEN source_app_code = '820000000058' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `微商城`, SUM(CASE WHEN source_app_code = '820000000057' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `微小店`, SUM(CASE WHEN source_app_code = '820000000147' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `门店`, SUM(CASE WHEN source_app_code = '820000000059' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `美业`, SUM(CASE WHEN source_app_code = '810007442800' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `普惠版`, SUM(CASE WHEN source_app_code = '810006902200' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `爱逛`, SUM(CASE WHEN source_app_code = '810006274300' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `教育`, SUM(CASE WHEN source_app_code = '810006729200' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `有赞客`, COUNT(1) AS `当日总量` FROM dm_pay.all_history_ucert_cert_info WHERE modify_type = 1 AND audit_time > '{{start_time}}' GROUP BY LEFT(audit_time, 10) ORDER BY stat_date DESC

start_time.description: 统计开始时间，默认近30天

output.description: 按日期返回各业务线的开店/认证数量

key_concepts.parent_node_no: 开店关系表中的业务线字段
key_concepts.source_app_code: 认证表中的业务线字段
key_concepts.modify_type: 认证修改类型，1=认证通过

dm_pay.pay_cc_org_relation.description: 组织关系表，存储开店关系

dm_pay.all_history_ucert_cert_info.description: 认证信息快照表，存储所有认证记录
dm_pay.all_history_ucert_cert_info.note: 无分区，查询务必加时间条件

typical_questions: 统计近一个月每日开店数量
各业务线每日认证通过趋势
微商城最近30天开店数据
